# Verified Research Lab

> Verified Research Lab independently reproduces results, replicates claims, and reviews methods, artifacts, and benchmarks in computer systems and software research.

The laboratory examines papers and artifacts, reconstructs computational environments, reruns experiments, audits comparisons, and records the limits of each conclusion.

## Core pages

- [Services](https://verifiedresearchlab.org/services/): Research reproduction and replication, claim and method review, artifact review, benchmark audits, independent reports, and technical due diligence.
- [Verification method](https://verifiedresearchlab.org/methods/): The six-stage claim-to-evidence process and evidence labels.
- [Public report registry](https://verifiedresearchlab.org/reports/): Versioned reports, responses, corrections, and revalidation status.
- [Governance](https://verifiedresearchlab.org/governance/): Sponsor separation, conflicts, factual review, evidence preservation, and correction policy.
- [About](https://verifiedresearchlab.org/about/): Current focus, technical scope, and boundaries.
- [Contact](https://verifiedresearchlab.org/contact/): How to discuss a paper, artifact, benchmark, or claim.

## Services

- [Research reproduction and replication](https://verifiedresearchlab.org/services/research-reproduction-and-replication/): Reruns reported results from supplied materials or tests the same claim through an independent replication.
- [Claim and method review](https://verifiedresearchlab.org/services/claim-and-method-review/): Assesses whether the method, analysis, and evidence support the stated claim.
- [Artifact review](https://verifiedresearchlab.org/services/artifact-readiness/): Checks whether code, data, environments, and instructions can be retrieved and executed independently, then assesses versioning, preservation, and hosting readiness.
- [Benchmark audit](https://verifiedresearchlab.org/services/benchmark-audits/): Tests baselines, workloads, measurements, statistics, and claimed advantages.
- [Independent verification report](https://verifiedresearchlab.org/services/independent-reports/): Publishes a versioned record of what reproduced, what replicated, what failed, and what remains uncertain.
- [Technical due diligence](https://verifiedresearchlab.org/services/technical-due-diligence/): Tests research-derived technology before investment, acquisition, procurement, or adoption.

## Important qualifications

- A review may cover an entire paper, but each conclusion remains tied to the claims, methods, artifacts, and conditions examined.
- A failure to reproduce does not by itself prove the underlying proposition false.
- Sponsors may fund work but may not direct conclusions.
- The public report registry currently contains no completed reports.
